beats: Driving at night, the story starts — but never says which house it's about.
Numbers came out as digits, and the voice misread them every time.
Now every story opens with its real address, pulled from Kartverket, spoken in Ukrainian and Norwegian.
And every number inside is spelled out in words, not digits.
Even the old stories are being rewritten the same way, one chapter at a time.
The result: a catalog with zero digits left to mishear.
